import Mathlib.Data.Real.Exp
import Mathlib.Tactic

theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) {t p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
  |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
  have key_inequality : |x| ≤ (p / |t|) * Real.exp (|t| * |x| / p) := by
    rw [Real.exp_div] at /=;
    have h1 : 0 < p ∨ p = 0 := le_or_gt zero_lt_one hp
    cases h1 with hp' hp'
    case hp' {
      let c := p / |t|
      have hc : 0 < c := by simp [hp', ht]
      have h2 : |t| * |x| / p = |t| * |x| / (p)
      rw [Real.exp_mul (Real.exp (|t| * |x| / p))] at h2
      have h3 : |x| ≤ c * Real.exp (|t| * |x| / p) :=
        Real.exp_ge_one hc
      rw [Real.exp_div] at h3
      exact h3
    }
    case hp' {
      have h4 : |x| ≤ (p / |t|) * 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_zero] at h4
        exact h4
      exact h4
    }
  have final_step : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.exp (|t| * |x|) := by
    rw [Real.pow_mul_right, Real.mul_pow, Real.pow_exp]
    exact Real.pow_le_mul (key_inequality) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  rw [max_eq_exp] at final_step
  exact final_step
